text:
zoe-partners: Starting thread for AtlasCloud marketplace onboarding. Need owners for IAM/KMS samples, legal addendum (rotation/audit), SKU manifest, staging screenshots, and launch comms. Quick takers?

leo-cloud: I got IAM/KMS samples for AWS/GCP/Azure. Will drop snippets and a Terraform example by Tue.

sam-legal: I'll draft the addendum. Atlas asked for explicit KMS customer key custody and a 180-day rotation window. Need exact SKU IDs to reference.

maya-product: I'll own SKU manifest + pricing tiers. Proposing ids: ["redwood-atlas-core", "redwood-atlas-dedicated", "redwood-atlas-trial"]. Will upload CSV shortly.

finn-ops: Trials need metadata: duration, seats cap, auto-expire. Also confirm support email to show on listing.

ada-eng: I'll produce staging screenshots and a 60s demo GIF. Requesting a staging publisher account from Zoe.

leo-cloud: AWS assumeRole snippet:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/MarketplacePublisher"}]}
```

leo-cloud: GCP impersonation (gcloud):
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding atlas-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member='serviceAccount:publisher@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'
```

leo-cloud: Azure role assignment (az):
```bash
az role assignment create --assignee <PUBLISHER_PRINCIPAL_ID> --role Owner --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
```

sam-legal: Once SKUs land I'll draft addendum. If partner insists on 180-day rotation I'll add language and an audit-access statement.

maya-product: CSV uploaded and SKU ids confirmed. Billing unit note: core = v-requests.

finn-ops: Support email = marketplace-support@redwood.ai. Partner confirmed anonymized telemetry share.

bot-deploy: New doc added: /docs/marketplace/atlas-manifest-draft.md

zoe-partners: Thanks. Action items: @leo-cloud -> IAM + TF example; @maya-product -> final manifest; @sam-legal -> draft addendum; @ada-eng -> staging assets. Weekly check Fri 11am. :rocket:
